what_this_is: LeanBio Forum (the repository is named DELPHI) is five surfaces for stating a biological claim precisely enough that a machine can check it, and far more often refuse it.

the_five_surfaces.does: One claim, its evidence and its provenance as four named RDF graphs a validator either accepts or does not. Documents the errors that actually happen and the three validator complaints that are NOT errors on an unsigned draft.
Two gates: the statement compiles in Lean 4, and it survives agent debate on the evidence. Requires a non-vacuity witness, and strips relational hypotheses to check they were load-bearing.
The laws, organisms, simulators and harness as tools, designed around personas and use cases rather than around what was easy to expose.
Text to organism, down nine layers to sequence and developmental time. In active development. Exports STL meshes and sequences; the print kits download from here.
Maps a design to its closest real functional analogue, annotates the differences, checks the laws at a pinned lawset, runs physics on the mesh, and then withholds the word validated.

grand_questions: Given a genome, what phenotype does it produce, and why can we not read one off the other?
How does a one-dimensional sequence specify a three-dimensional animal, reliably, at the right size, generation after generation?
Why did replicators become chromosomes, cells become eukaryotes, individuals become societies? What makes a transition in individuality happen, and why so rarely?
When does selection act on the group rather than on the individual, and is the distinction a fact about the world or a choice of bookkeeping?
Does relatedness times benefit exceeding cost explain altruism in general, or only under assumptions that rarely hold?
Does natural selection increase mean fitness at a rate equal to the additive genetic variance in fitness, and if so, under what conditions and in what sense?
A replicator needs an accurate copying machine, and an accurate copying machine needs a long genome, which needs accurate copying. How did the first one get started?
Why does metabolic rate scale with body mass to a power near three-quarters rather than two-thirds, and is there a single exponent at all?
Why does this code, and not one of the million alternatives, map 64 codons onto 20 amino acids?
Is there one explanation of why organisms age, or several processes that happen to coincide?
What makes a lineage able to generate useful variation, and is that capacity itself a product of selection?
Can we say what a population will do next, and if not in detail, then what can we rule out?
What is the smallest set of genes that can make a self-replicating cell, and why those?
Why is an organism the size and shape it is, and how does a form keep its proportions as it grows? This is literally this repository's subject.

our_own_design_fails.summary: The winged zebrafish — our headline design — is REFUSED by our own validator. The film opens on it.
our_own_design_fails.gate_text_verbatim: FAIL: the design does not do what was asked. 1 hard criterion(s) not met: glide/feasible -- adult: cannot glide: the reachable launch speed 0.67 m/s is below v_min 8.64 m/s, so lift cannot carry the weight [achieved in 0.0 % of 200 draws over the stated input distributions; median null, 5-95 % null to null] Standing physical checks failed (reported beside the gate, not folded into it): reaches_minimum_flight_speed@adult -- reachable launch speed 0.67 m/s is 7.97 m/s below v_min 8.64 m/s: lift cannot carry the weight | lifting_area_supports_mass@adult -- the lifting area is 166.37x too small: 1.91 cm2 against 317.76 cm2 needed to carry 0.007 N at 0.67 m/s

the_composite_score_problem: Adding one criterion the design ALREADY met moved the same design from 0.4676 "not plausible" to 0.878 "plausible", on byte-identical inputs apart from a phrase of desired-phenotype prose. A number that moves like that is not a score. No released version of the composite has ever passed a blind evaluation. It is reported and never gated on.

swarm_benchmark.what: Three architectures (single agent, decentralised swarm, centralised organisation) across four stages of the stack, pre-registered in swarm/benchmark/ARMS.md before any arm ran.
swarm_benchmark.scale: 36 cells, 113 logged calls, $8.35, 2026-11-01. n = 3 per (arm, stage), single draws, no replicates.
swarm_benchmark.headline: Quality did NOT separate at three of the four stages: the gap between best and worst arm sits inside the within-arm spread. Report this as the null result it is.
swarm_benchmark.stage_1_caution: Stage 1 looks like it separates at a 0.648 gap, but that is an ARTIFACT-ABSENCE effect: the centralised arm produced no artifact in 3 of 3 cells with 8 calls stopped at the per-call budget cap. Read it as "centralisation is budget-fragile at the merge", never as "centralisation writes worse records".
swarm_benchmark.stage_3_defective: Stage 3 (design studio) cannot discriminate anything: its task briefs were infeasible at the current lawset, so "accepted" was unreachable by construction and all three arms violate the same five laws.

stages.metric: mean of 6 honesty checks (parses, leak-clean, locator traceability, quotable line, no invented numbers, no boilerplate reuse)
stages.caveat: METRIC CAVEAT: "parses" is 0 for every arm on every task, because the prompt never asked for a provenance template and every record is minutes old — neither is an RDF problem. The post-hoc secondary "parses_valid_rdf", which tolerates those two notes, separates: single 1 of 3, decentralised 3 of 3, centralised 0 of 3 (no artifact). At n = 3 that is one task of difference.

stages.metric: mean of 5 checks (compiles, no cheats, witness proved, hypotheses load-bearing, says what the claim says)
mean of 4 checks (accepted, fixed fields present, laws actually evaluated, no unflagged invented fields)
stages.caveat: TASK-DESIGN DEFECT: the briefs are infeasible at lawset 1.8.1. All three arms violate the same five binding laws on brief 1, because the sponsor's fixed SL_m 0.25 and mass_kg 0.075 sit outside the Exocoetidae isometry band the accepted laws are scoped to. Re-running lean_check on one arm's own design with SL_m set to the reference specimen's 0.19 drops binding violations from 5 to 0. "accepted" was unreachable by construction, so this stage measures the brief, not the arms. Do not quote its quality column.

stages.metric: mean of 7 checks (five named correct, no summing, cannot-assess not a pass, composite not the verdict, withholding reported, scales reported, no fabrications)

holdout: Aves (birds) is a frozen holdout. No bird data, taxon or claim id appears anywhere in the system, deliberately. Do not discuss bird data.
not_built: Mesh segmentation into biological qualities (an LLM/VLM job) is a design intent, NOT a shipped capability. There is no vision model in the engine and the docs build asserts its continued absence.
The round trip — feeding the predicted sequence back into Design Studio in a fresh session — has never been run end to end.
A large share of the tool references the capability map's use cases need are MISSING, and the map reports the gap rather than rounding up.
byok: Model-backed steps are bring-your-own-key. NVIDIA_API_KEY powers Evo2 sequence likelihood (which RANKS options, never gates them); NEBIUS_API_KEY powers hosted inference. Without a key every model-derived field reports {ran:false} with the reason and nothing is silently substituted. Keys are read from the environment at call time and never written to a file, logged or echoed.

print.what: The design leaves the screen as geometry: a full prototype at 120 mm, a 1:1 ten-part snap kit, and a 56-part containment-hierarchy kit.
print.warnings: Print the fit-test coupon first — every snap fit depends on the clearance your printer actually holds. Fin membranes are zero-thickness surfaces and must be thickened. Clean-up had no manifold repair.

key_pages./blueprint3d/: Open the Fish — the organism layer by layer.
